note: Enumerated values used across the schema.

communitySize.label: Large
communitySize.description: A few hundred to a few thousand members

costValues.label: Often
costValues.description: Applies frequently but not universally; depends on community size or activity.

costValues.label: Sometimes
costValues.description: Applies in some configurations or at some scale.

costValues.label: Rare
costValues.description: Technically possible but uncommon in practice.

federationApproach.label: Open
federationApproach.description: Default to federating with everyone; block specific bad actors as needed.

federationApproach.label: Allowlist only
federationApproach.description: Default to not federating; explicitly allow a curated list of trusted servers.

federationApproach.label: Blocklist only
federationApproach.description: Maintain only a blocklist; no formal allowlist.

federationResponseLadder.label: Warn
federationResponseLadder.description: Issue a warning to the other server's moderators.

federationResponseLadder.label: Mute
federationResponseLadder.description: Hide the server's content from federated timelines without blocking.

federationResponseLadder.label: Discuss
federationResponseLadder.description: Internal moderator discussion before deciding next action.

federationResponseLadder.label: Ghost
federationResponseLadder.description: Bonfire-specific: silently drop interactions without visible block.

conflictStep.label: Escalation
conflictStep.description: Used if the primary approach doesn't resolve the conflict.

conflictStep.label: Last resort
conflictStep.description: Used only when other approaches have failed.

conflictStep.label: Parallel
conflictStep.description: Used alongside other approaches, not sequentially.
